claims.title: Shared-service contact observation: physical B-opening and shunt invariance

quoted_fields.interface: Same functional A path and part retained through an actual independent B opening. Closed/open conductance errors each<=e, actual unwanted-shunt change bounded by gamma, nonnegative series contributions and suitable installed current/compliance. Lead switching in software is not the physical intervention.
quoted_fields.failure: The certificate assumes invariant or independently bounded shunt conductance during B opening. Motion of contamination, A-load/frame changes or unverified conductor separation can violate it. Counterexamples concern the specified linear ports, not every sensor. Full paired-contact qualification, tooling, wear, service recovery and production advantage remain open.
